evaluated.note: Model under evaluation. Thinking level HIGH; temperature 0 and a fixed seed reduce run-to-run variation (three identical answers to a probe on 2026-09-29), but the provider does not guarantee identical output. Plain API calls, no tools.

competitor.note: Competitor expected to be stronger. Effort xhigh. This model rejects sampling parameters (temperature returns HTTP 400, checked 2026-09-29), so its output cannot be pinned.

observer.note: Judge of process integrity, from a third model family; blinded; never decides pass/fail. The provider only allows temperature 1 for this model (checked 2026-09-29), so reports vary between runs; that is acceptable because reports never decide anything.
